paper.title_en: Forecasting Strongly Lensed Binary Black Hole Rates from the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background with TianQin
paper.abstract_en: The millihertz stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) provides a population-level probe of stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) and their cosmic merger history. We develop a framework using TianQin alone to propagate SGWB-informed BBH population constraints into forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers detectable by ground-based gravitational-wave detectors. The framework distinguishes between lensed events with at least one detected image and lens systems in which both images are detected and successfully associated. Using a one-year mock observation, we infer the BBH population and propagate the resulting posterior through a galaxy-scale lensing model with image-level selection. For the adopted system-magnification threshold, \(μ_{\rm sys}\ge 2\), the median predicted rate of lensed events with at least one detected image is \(R_{\rm event}^{\rm det}=5.50\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\), while the median rate of associated two-image lens systems is \(R_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=2.54\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\); the median detectable system fraction is \(\mathcal{F}_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=3.35\times10^{-4}\). Compared with the prior-only propagation, the pooled 16th--84th percentile widths decrease by 6.5\% for the event rate, 6.4\% for the system rate, and 4.0\% for the system fraction. Our work establishes a quantitative link between millihertz SGWB inference and forecasts of strongly lensed BBH mergers for ground-based gravitational-wave observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将天琴毫赫兹随机引力波背景对恒星级双黑洞族群的推断，与地面探测器强透镜双黑洞并合率的预报定量连接起来，并区分了至少探测到一个像的透镜事件与两像均被探测并关联的透镜系统，给出了具体的率预测及相对先验的区间收窄幅度。属于随机引力波背景与族群推断方向，方法链条清晰，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 利用天琴预报由随机引力波背景得到的强透镜双黑洞事件率
decision.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹随机引力波背景（SGWB）为恒星级双黑洞（BBH）及其宇宙并合历史提供了族群层面的探针。我们构建了一个仅使用天琴的框架，将基于SGWB的BBH族群约束传播为对地面引力波探测器可探测的强透镜BBH并合的预报。该框架区分两类情形：至少探测到一个像的透镜事件，以及两个像均被探测并成功关联的透镜系统。使用一年的模拟观测，我们推断BBH族群，并将所得后验通过带有像级选择的星系尺度透镜模型进行传播。对于所采用的系统放大率阈值 \(μ_{\rm sys}\ge 2\)，至少探测到一个像的透镜事件率中位预测值为 \(R_{\rm event}^{\rm det}=5.50\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\)，而关联的两像透镜系统率中位值为 \(R_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=2.54\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{yr}^{-1}\)；可探测系统比例的中位值为 \(\mathcal{F}_{\rm sys}^{\rm det}=3.35\times10^{-4}\)。与仅基于先验的传播相比，合并的16--84百分位区间宽度在事件率上减小6.5\%，在系统率上减小6.4\%，在系统比例上减小4.0\%。我们的工作建立了毫赫兹SGWB推断与面向地面引力波观测的强透镜BBH并合预报之间的定量联系。
